    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias or lag",
    "The forecast gap increases in early forecast horizons, then narrows around 20-30 days out",
    "High sentiment (>=0.67) in history correlates with slightly higher true outcomes than model predicts",
    "When history prices are declining, model underforecasts more severely than when prices are flat or rising",
    "Sentiment turning negative (below 0) in history precedes outcomes that are higher than model forecasts",
    "Model tends to overshoot downward at 1-10 day horizons, then mean-reverts to be slightly below true values at 20-30 days",
    "Sentiment history being mixed (not strongly positive) correlates with model forecasts being too low"
] }
